'''Ye Minghan''' ({{zh|s=叶铭汉}}; 2 April 1925 – 4 October 2024) was a Chinese physicist who served as director of the Institute of High Energy Physics of the Chinese Academy of Sciences from 1984 to 1988, and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Engineering]]. He was a member of the [[China Democratic League]].<ref name="ye">{{cite news |url=https://new.qq.com/rain/a/20241004A06I9000 |script-title=zh:痛悼！99岁院士、著名实验高能物理学家叶铭汉逝世 |work=qq.com |date=4 October 2024 |access-date=5 October 2024 |language=zh}}</ref>

== Early life and career ==
Ye was born into an intellectual Family in [[Shanghai]] on 2 April 1925.<ref name="Song">{{cite news |url=https://finance.sina.com.cn/tech/discovery/2024-10-05/doc-incrnksa3303025.shtml |script-title=zh:叶铭汉院士：为我国高能物理实验研究开辟新天地 |work=qq.com |date=5 October 2024 |access-date=5 October 2024 |language=zh}}</ref> His uncle [[Ye Qisun]] was an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite news |author1=Hao Jun ({{lang|zh|郝俊}}) |url=https://www.cas.cn/xw/cmsm/201304/t20130426_3827527.shtml#:~:text=1942%E5%B9%B4%EF%BC%8C |script-title=zh:【中国科学报】最后的大师——叶铭汉与他的叔父叶企孙 |work=cas.cn |date=26 April 2013 |access-date=5 October 2024 |language=zh}}</ref> He attended Sasaipo Elementary School ({{zh|s=萨赛坡小学|labels=no}}), Affiliated Middle School of [[Aurora University]] (now Shanghai Xiangming High School), and  Affiliated High School of [[Utopia University]] (now Shanghai Datong High School).

Ye transferred to the Affiliated High School of the Normal College of Central University in 1942 and enrolled at [[National Southwestern Associated University]] in 1944.<ref name="Song"/> In April 1944, Ye participated in the Youth Expeditionary Force and was assigned to the First Temporary Automobile Regiment of the Chinese Army stationed in [[British India]].<ref name="Song"/>

In May 1946, Ye was accepted to the School of Science, [[Tsinghua University]], and worked at the Institute of Modern Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences after graduating in 1950.<ref name="Song"/> Ye was an assistant researcher at the Institute of Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences in 1953 and subsequently assistant researcher at the Institute of Atomic Energy, Chinese Academy of Sciences in 1958.

In 1964, Ye went to the countryside to participate in the socialist education movement and was sent to the [[May Seventh Cadre Schools]] to do farm works in [[Qianjiang, Hubei|Qianjiang County]] (now Qianjiang), [[Hubei]] in 1969.

Ye was reinstated as an associate researcher of the Institute of High Energy Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences in 1973 and rose to become director in 1984.<ref name="Song"/> Ye was a visiting scholar at [[Princeton University]] in 1979, visiting professor at the [[University of Utah]] in 1981, and visiting professor at [[Brookhaven National Laboratory]] from 1990 to 1993.

== Personal life and death ==
Ye was married to Yin Weiyi ({{zh|s=殷蔚薏|labels=no}}).<ref>{{cite news |url=http://www.chinafotobank.com/%20/picture.do?method=getpicture1&id=363443&order= |script-title=zh:叶铭汉与夫人殷蔚薏 |work=chinafotobank.com |date=15 April 2014 |access-date=5 October 2024 |language=zh}}</ref>

On 4 October 2024, Ye died in [[Beijing]] at the age of 99.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.guancha.cn/politics/2024_10_04_750724.shtml#:~:text=10%E6%9C%884%E6%97%A5%EF%BC%8C |script-title=zh:著名实验高能物理学家叶铭汉逝世，享年99岁 |work=guancha.cn |date=4 October 2024 |access-date=5 October 2024 |language=zh}}</ref>

== Honours and awards ==
* 1990 State Science and Technology Progress Award (Special Prize) for the Beijing Electron Positron Collider and Beijing Spectrometer.<ref name="ye"/>
* 1995 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Engineering]] (CAE)<ref name="ye"/>
